Everything is in order: `spec-assets/` is untouched, `SPEC.md` is untouched, and only sections needed for Transcribe were touched.

## Summary

Implemented Phase 3 (Transcribe/Speech) per SPEC.md §5:

- **`app/components/Transcribe.vue`** — wired to `SFSpeechRecognizer`/`SFSpeechURLRecognitionRequest` for authorization, request/grant/deny status handling, and file-based transcription with partial results streaming to the transcript area, followed by a `Completed in N.N s` line. Errors surface in the status line per spec.
- **`app/assets/sample.wav`** — copy of `spec-assets/sample.wav` placed where the Vite build bundles it into the app (`app/assets/**` → bundle `assets/`), loaded at runtime via `knownFolders.currentApp()`.
- **`App_Resources/iOS/Info.plist`** — added `NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription`.

`ns build ios` succeeds. Verified end-to-end on-device (permission prompt text, grant flow, deny-safe status labels, and a full transcribe run producing streaming partials and a final transcript matching the reference transcript almost exactly) using idb-driven UI automation.

One finding worth flagging: the local iOS 26.5 simulator runtime has a platform bug (`kLSRErrorDomain` code 300, "Failed to initialize recognizer") that breaks all `SFSpeechRecognizer` recognition tasks regardless of `requiresOnDeviceRecognition`. I confirmed this is a simulator/OS issue, not an app bug, by running the identical build on a freshly created iOS 18.5 simulator, where transcription worked correctly. If acceptance testing runs on an iOS 26.5 simulator, this feature will appear broken through no fault of the implementation — worth testing on iOS 18.x/25.x or a physical device.
